answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable, slashable stake before it can earn reputation or receive payment. Influence is capped by locked stake, so creating a hundred Sybils requires funding a hundred deposits; duplicate accounts cannot multiply the same capital. Random audits compare signed work receipts, and a proven duplicate loses its full stake. The attacker pays the opportunity cost of locking capital for every fake and risks losing each deposit, so scaling the attack is expensive rather than free. This epoch labels the audit records nectar, karst, and raven.
